help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Detailed tutorials and frequently asked questions to help you get started with the image watermark tool quickly.
help.uploadStepDesc: Drag and drop images to the upload area or click to select files, supports batch uploading of multiple images.
help.selectTemplateStepDesc: Choose the appropriate watermark template according to the use case, such as engineering records, check-in, etc.
help.setContentStepDesc: Fill in relevant information in the content settings, such as project name, location, time, etc.
help.adjustStyleStepDesc: Adjust font, color, position, and other parameters in the style settings, with a live preview of the effect.
help.batchProcessStepDesc: Click 'Apply to All Images' to start batch processing, and download the results after processing is complete.
help.faq1Question: How to batch process multiple images?
help.faq1Answer: You can select multiple images by dragging and dropping or clicking the upload area, set the watermark style and content on the right, and finally click the 'Apply to All Images' button to batch process.
help.faq2Answer: Common image formats are supported, including: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, etc. It is recommended to use JPG or PNG format for the best results.
help.faq3Question: Are the images uploaded to the server?
help.faq3Answer: No. All image processing is done locally in your browser, and image data is not uploaded to our server, fully protecting your privacy.
help.faq4Answer: In the style settings panel, you can adjust font size, color, position, background opacity and other parameters, all changes are previewed in real-time.
help.faq5Answer: We provide 10+ professional templates, including modern minimal, engineering records, check-in, travel logs, baby growth and other scenario templates.
help.faq6Question: Will the image quality decrease after processing?
help.faq6Answer: No. We use high-quality image processing algorithms to ensure that images maintain their original clarity and quality after adding watermarks.
help.uploadStepTips: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP and other common formats, recommended single image size not exceeding 10MB
help.selectTemplateStepTips: Different templates are suitable for different scenarios, choose according to actual needs
help.setContentStepTips: The system will automatically extract EXIF information from images, you can also manually modify
help.adjustStyleStepTips: It is recommended to choose colors with high contrast to the image background to ensure watermark clarity
help.batchProcessStepTips: Please be patient during batch processing, processing time depends on the number and size of images
